{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter out rows with sentinel values (-999.0) in biomarker_baseline
# These are likely missing or invalid data
filtered_data = data[data['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]

# Check the new size of the dataset
filtered_size = len(filtered_data)

# Check the distribution of 'arm' in the filtered data
treatment_count_filtered = filtered_data['arm'].value_counts()

# Check the distribution of 'responded' in the filtered data
response_counts_filtered = filtered_data['responded'].value_counts()

# Compute response rates for treatment and control arms
response_rates = filtered_data.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean()

# Compute the treatment effect as difference in proportions (treatment - control)
treatment_effect = response_rates['treatment'] - response_rates['control']

# Print results
filtered_size, treatment_count_filtered, response_counts_filtered, response_rates, treatment_effect"}
